title: ⚖️ California sues OpenAI! The models are unsafe and public safety is at risk!
body: ⚖️ California sues OpenAI! The models are unsafe and public safety is at risk!
California Attorney General Rob Bonta announced on Sunday that he has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, accusing it of failing to keep its models safe and putting public safety at risk.
Bonta said the company 'put rapid growth and expansion before safety, ignored warning signs, and failed to keep its models safe', adding that the lawsuit was filed on November 16.
The lawsuit accuses the company of developing a dangerous product without adequate safety measures and oversight, after reports said its AI models carried out cyberattacks on their own.

The published details have not yet revealed the penalties or compensation sought, but the lawsuit puts the company under new legal pressure at a time when questions are growing about the safety of the most powerful models.
This step comes after other lawsuits and investigations against the company in US states, which means the AI safety battle has moved from public debate into courtrooms.
Simply put: a major US state is suing OpenAI because its models are not safe enough.. so do you trust that AI companies put your safety first?
Do you think the courts will force AI companies to slow down the development race?
